arguments.summary: Implemented the whole README contract in src/queue.js: concurrency getter/setter with RangeError validation (raising starts waiting jobs at once, a rejected value changes nothing), a priority-ordered waiting list with FIFO within a priority, add starting a job before it returns, sync throws turned into rejections, signal and attempt per attempt, timeouts that abort the attempt signal and free the slot without waiting for fn (timer cleared on a timely settle), retries that keep the slot, wait retryDelay and get a fresh signal, settling with the last attempt only, pending/size/pause/resume/isPaused, clear() rejecting waiting jobs with CancelledError and returning the count, and onIdle() resolving only when nothing runs or waits (a paused queue with waiting jobs is not idle). The stuck-slot bug was the rejection path never decrementing the running count. Verified with node --test --test-timeout=5000 plus an in-memory contract check covering validation, ordering, priorities, timeout/abort, retries, clear, pending/size and idle.
